analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI is consolidating in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. ADX at 31.0 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (33.1) is still stronger than +DI (23.7), suggesting a persistent weak trend. Positioned at 42.6% of 52-week range, near the lower bound, and down 13.43% from weekly SMA20. Considering volatility (ATR 4.54%), maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of clear directional momentum.
